messages:
aj_releases: deploybot blocked rc-2.4.0 canary due to a transitive package with missing SBOM provenance. need decision: pin/carveout/hotpatch/delay. cc @maria_dev @noah_sre @lisa_legal

deploy-bot: ``
ID: release-rc-2.4.0
package: libfastreq@1.2.3 (transitive)
flag: SBOM_PROVENANCE_MISSING
scan: CVE-2026-12345 (severity: low, cvss:3.3)
action: BLOCK_CANARY
``

maria_dev: low severity but unsigned provenance is a compliance risk for finance telemetry. where does it come from?
aj_releases: analytics-service -> http-client -> libfastreq. only used in new telemetry endpoint. no public exploit reports, scanner complains cosign missing.

noah_sre: we can carve out regionally (EU-only) for the canary, but that affects routing and capacity. fallback plan needed. :thinking: 
lisa_legal: legal flags this as "compliance-sensitive" until provenance is verified. we want either signed digest or written exception.
tom_qe: do our staged tests exercise that telemetry path? if not, we should pin and run full regression during canary.

maria_dev: proposal: pin to a known digest for canary + EU regional carveout, run 2h canary with QE regression. open ticket to get cosign evidence and schedule hotpatch in next change window to replace transitive dep.

noah_sre: agreed. plan of action:
1) releasesctl pin --pkg libfastreq@sha256:0a1b2c3d --scope canary:rc-2.4.0
2) deploybot canary --id rc-2.4.0 --region eu --duration 2h --note "pin due to SBOM provenance missing"
3) monitor error budget + perf dashboards; rollback on SLO breach.

deploy-bot: Executing preview:
``
releasesctl pin --pkg libfastreq@sha256:0a1b2c3d --scope canary:rc-2.4.0
deploybot canary --id rc-2.4.0 --region eu --duration 2h --note "pin digest due to SBOM provenance missing"
``
aj_releases: also adding release note line: "Partial EU canary carved out due to SBOM provenance verification pending; full rollout contingent on hotpatch and signed artifact." will notify sales for affected enterprise customers.
lisa_legal: fine if we create security/sbom-provenance + legal-review tickets and escalate if any finance customer asks.
tom_qe: I'll attach regression suite to the canary and run smoke every 15m.
maria_dev: prepping pin PR and release note snippet now, will tag aj_releases when ready. :white_check_mark:
aj_releases: starting pin + canary. will update thread when metrics look stable. :rocket:
